name: Roetten Stonehammer
summary: In Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, Roetten Stonehammer organizes expeditions for Reclaimers Inc. He hires adventurers to recover salvage in distant lands such as Desolace.

sections.title: Business in the Library
sections.body: Roetten Stonehammer handles recovery work for Reclaimers Inc. from the Library in the Hall of Explorers. He connects mercenaries with salvage work across Kalimdor. His associates seek valuable cargo, wreckage, and rare reagents in dangerous lands such as Desolace.

faq.answer: Roetten Stonehammer works in the Library of Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. He coordinates expeditions and hires adventurers for Reclaimers Inc.'s recovery work abroad.
Reclaimers Inc. salvages lost shipments, gathers rare reagents, and investigates valuable wrecks in dangerous lands such as Desolace.
Roetten sends travelers across the sea to Desolace in western Kalimdor. His partners seek shipwreck salvage and reagents along its rugged coast and barren wilderness.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can find Roetten in Ironforge's grand archives, where archaeological curiosity meets commercial salvage.
As an Alliance member, you can look to Roetten in Ironforge for expeditions across the sea to Desolace in Kalimdor.
